A little about me

Hi, I’m Sonya.
Italy is home.
For now.

A Latvian in northern Italy, with a chapter in Toronto along the way. Sharing the small moments that make a new place feel like home.

A LIFE ACROSS BORDERSAlways a little curious.
The story so far

New places.
Familiar feelings.

Moving abroad has been part of my life since I was sixteen. Over the years, I’ve lived in three countries across two continents, learning what it means to start over and find my place.

Now I live in northern Italy, work a full-time job and make content around the life in between: exploring, learning, travelling and noticing the little things.

My content is a way of sharing that experience — and connecting with people figuring out their own next chapter.
